The '''Battle of the Thesme sector''' was a battle fought in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] forces eventually retreated from the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] after inflicting thirty percent casualties on a [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] task force.<ref name="Forgotten War" />
